svg.title: 16. Hands behind biceps stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Join your hands behind your hips. Straighten your elbows without locking them. Move your hands a small distance away from your back.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Standing_Biceps_Stretch.json
